tool_description: Search for and retrieve scientific scholarly articles from the arXiv repository.

api_list.name: search_paper
api_list.description: Performs an advanced search for scientific papers. It returns metadata including the paper title, authors, abstract, publication date, and direct links to the PDF. It allows for complex filtering using authors, specific titles, and categories.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: General keywords to search across all fields.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Filter by a specific word or phrase in the paper title.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Filter by a specific author's name.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: ArXiv category code (e.g., 'cs.AI' for Artificial Intelligence, 'physics.gen-ph').

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to return. Default is 10.
